message:
- **You push it** -- Instructions: purview.microsoft.com → eDiscovery → Content Search → new search → select all locations (leave the query empty for everything) → run → Export → tick "Include Teams and Viva Engage conversations" → download from Process manager; grab the user roster separately at admin.microsoft.com → Users → Active users → Export users. Lands as one PST per mailbox, native Office files per OneDrive/SharePoint site (folder structure preserved), HTML transcripts for chats, and a users .csv, expect very large downloads on a slow drip. Requires the eDiscovery Manager role, and per-plan/per-form Excel exports cover Planner boards and Forms responses one at a time.

Let me know if you have any questions or would like us to pull this!
notes: Export requires the eDiscovery Manager role and downloads are very large on a slow drip.
Planner boards and Forms responses export per plan or per form to Excel, one at a time.
